name: NCL Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1979, NCL Industries Ltd manufactures and sells Cement, RMC, CBPB, Doors, and operates 2 SHP projects[1]
keyPoints:

NCLIL is a part of the NCL group. Its core operations include the manufacturing of cement, cement particle boards, and Ready-Mix Concrete. The company has 2000 + Dealers / Distributors

cons: Company has a low return on equity of 6.86% over last 3 years.
